messages.author: afc5d1777b0456fc
messages.subject: Another master thesis using Stan
parts:
Dear all,
I have completed my MSc in Statistics thesis using Stan. It involved several Bayesian hierarchical models, which have been included in the R package eggCounts.  
Here is the reference according to Stan citation page format:
Craig Wang. 2016. Bayesian Hierarchical Modelling of Zero-Inflated Faecal Egg Counts. ETH Zurich, Deptartment of Mathematics. Master Thesis.
http://dx.doi.org/10.3929/ethz-a-010695750

Craig
